module.purpose: Provides public clipboard-copy utilities for exporting selected editor shapes as JSON, SVG, or PNG.
module.summary: This module coordinates shape extraction, image export, MIME-type preparation, and browser clipboard APIs. It prefers synchronous clipboard-item creation for Safari compatibility, supports JSON text directly, adds compatible alternate MIME types for image formats, and falls back to asynchronous SVG text copying when clipboard write is unavailable.
module.businessContext: Supports copying drawing content from the editor into other applications. Failures prevent users from transferring selected shapes through the clipboard.
classes: CopyAsOptions (~L19-22): Options describing the requested clipboard format and image export settings.
functions: copyAs (~L33-79): Copies selected editor shapes to the clipboard in the requested format.
fallbackWriteTextAsync (~L81-83): Asynchronously writes generated text through the browser clipboard.

detail.name: copyAs
detail.signature: export function copyAs(editor: Editor, ids: TLShapeId[], opts: CopyAsOptions): Promise<void>
preconditions: The global navigator object is available.
editor provides the content or SVG export operations required by the selected format.
opts contains a supported copy format.
postconditions: Returns a Promise<void> representing completion of the clipboard write or fallback text write.
For JSON format, the current-page content for ids is serialized with tab indentation and passed to navigator.clipboard.writeText.
For supported image formats, the exported blob is written to the clipboard with its MIME type and, when supported, an additional clipboard MIME type.
invariants: The function itself is not async and initiates clipboard item creation and navigator.clipboard.write synchronously when that API is available.
edgeCases: When navigator.clipboard is unavailable, returns a rejected promise with Error('Copy not supported').
When opts.format is 'json', serializes editor.getContentFromCurrentPage(ids) using JSON.stringify with null replacer and '\t' space indentation.
When clipboard.write is unavailable and opts.format is 'svg', asynchronously obtains the SVG string and writes it as fallback text.
When clipboard.write is unavailable and opts.format is 'png', throws Error('Copy not supported').
When SVG export produces no result, the fallback path throws Error('Failed to copy').

raises: Error('Copy not supported') when navigator.clipboard is unavailable
Error('Copy not supported') when clipboard.write is unavailable for PNG format
Error('Failed to copy') when SVG export returns no result

detail.ioFormatSpec: JSON format writes JSON.stringify(content, null, '\t') as plain clipboard text. Image formats write an exported Blob under its MIME type and may also write the same blob rewritten to an additional supported MIME type. SVG fallback writes the exported SVG string as text.
detail.summary: Copies the selected shapes in the requested format using the available browser clipboard API. JSON is written as formatted text, while image formats use clipboard image export with text fallbacks where supported.
